demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Real estate industry remained cautious in FY26, with developers consolidating and exhausting existing inventory before launching new projects, and buyers/investors waiting for further price correction.
- High inventory levels persisted in key markets despite a sharp drop in new launches following RERA implementation.
- Government initiatives such as the Smart City Project (100 smart cities) and a dedicated affordable-housing fund proposed in Budget 2026 are expected to open opportunities, particularly in the mid/affordable housing segment.
- RERA stabilization is expected to attract consumers via lower interest rates and tax benefits on housing.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Company discloses that changes in regulatory norms in India shall affect its operations.
- Company flags that an increase in the price of energy sources could significantly increase operating expenses.
- MD&A notes the real estate industry continued to have high inventory levels in key markets despite a sharp drop in new launches following RERA implementation, with developers consolidating rather than launching new projects.
- The Company's standalone and consolidated revenue for the year was earned entirely from sale of Copper Futcom (a commodity futures transaction) rather than from its stated real estate business.
- Debt Equity Ratio increased during the year, attributed by the Company to an increase in debt.
- Company incurred a net loss for the year, with Return on Equity and Return on Capital Employed both turning negative, attributed by the Company to the loss during the period.
